entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-08-16
entry.content:
Issues

Closed

  • [iOS] SafeArea arrange insets are currently insetting based on an incorrect Bounds #24246
    .NET 9 Servicing
  • ScrollView inside a Grid expands width past device screen when rotated #27715
    .NET 10.0-rc2

Updated

  • [Windows] Change the LineStackingStrategy to BlockLineHeight for Labels on Windows #24520
    .NET 9 Servicing
  • The status bar is blank when ManualMAUITests sample project debugging on the “Android16.0- API 36” emulator #29954
    .NET 10.0-rc1
  • What's going on with the splash-screen? #12395
    Backlog
  • [NET10, iOS] SafeArea with SoftInput needs to disable the keyboard auto scroll when there is no scorllview #31190
    .NET 10.0-rc2
  • [iOS] SafeArea doesn't properly account for how much of a view is under the soft input #31191
    .NET 10.0-rc2
